meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation review orchestrator. Launches 5 parallel background sub-agents: Oracle (goal/constraint verification), Oracle (code quality), Oracle (security), unspecified-high (hands-on QA execution), unspecified-high (context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion). All must pass for review to pass. MUST USE before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. Triggers: 'review work', 'review my work', 'review changes', 'QA my work', 'verify implementation', 'check my work', 'validate changes', 'post-implementation review'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动并行审查已完成工作的质量、安全与目标一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交PR前自动进行多维度审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review completed work across quality, security, and goal alignment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated multi-dimensional review before PR submission

howto.what: 技能会启动 5 个后台子代理并行审查已完成的工作:一个核对是否按原目标做成,一个实际运行程序验证能不能用,一个审查代码质量,一个检查安全性,一个从 GitHub、git、Slack、Notion 等渠道挖掘遗漏的上下文。任何一项不通过,整体就不通过。
howto.when: 当你在 PR 交接前或明确要求审查已完成的工作时触发,例如说「review work」「QA my work」「check my work」等。

say.text: 帮我审查我改的这段代码,重点看有没有漏掉需求。
say.note: 会触发 5 个子代理并行复查。

say.text: 跑一下 review,查查这次改动会不会有安全问题。
say.note: 安全审计代理会专门检查此处。

say.text: PR 提交前,把这次实现完整审查一遍。
say.note: 有任一项不通过就不会放行。

howto.what_en: Launches 5 background sub-agents in parallel to review completed work: goal check, hands-on run, code quality, security, and context mining from GitHub/git/Slack/Notion. All five must pass for the review to pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work, e.g. saying 'review work', 'QA my work', or 'check my work'.

say_en.text: Review the code I changed, focus on missed requirements.
Run the review and check this change for security issues.
say_en.note: The security audit agent inspects it.

say_en.text: Do a full review of this implementation before I submit the PR.
say_en.note: No pass until all lanes pass.
